    InactivityCheck
    D2's check on the engine (END-4): with two robots that never hit each other, does the one with more energy survive Robocode's inactivity penalty?
    LiveDetails
    Reads a saved LiteRumble BotDetails page (MIME, HTML table: rank, name, APS, APS CI, NPP, survival, KNNPBI, battles, latest battle, opponent APS, opponent survival) and reports APS and survival by opponent-APS band, by UTC hour of the latest battle, a before/after split at a given time, and, when a bench report is given, live minus bench share for every opponent the two have in common (BENCH-5).

    One row of the BotDetails table: one live pairing against one opponent.

    SessionRunner
    BENCH-6: runs a list of battles one after another through ONE engine in this JVM, the way a rumble client does, and writes a result.csv per battle plus one session.csv row per battle as it goes, so a session that dies still leaves its rows.
    ShieldProbe
    BENCH-11: the shield probe.
    ShieldProbe.Activity

    Stats
    Mean and 95% confidence half-width (Student's t) of a small sample.
    TeamHarvester
    Watches a team battle from the outside, for A5's gate.
    TeamReport
    A5's team report: per opponent team, the score share and rounds won (as the TeamRumble scores them), how often a member of ours lived to the round's end, and the team gate's counts: faults and skipped turns, link reports rejected (LINK-3), shots that left with a living teammate truly in the lane (WEAVE-4), each member's count of enemies alive below the truth (WORLD-8), the members' own team records (T), and the data files the battle left behind (SHELF-2: no duel or melee shelf, and only the leader writes).
    TeamReport.Battle
    One battle: its result and what its members printed.
    TeamRunner
    Runs one team battle in this JVM (A5) and writes team.csv into the battle directory: one row per team, by score.
    WaveMatcher
    Scores the waves Hadur inferred against the bullets the enemy really fired (S2's wave fidelity).
